test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - Reasoning Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A − B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is T related to Q if ‘P − Q + R − S ÷ T × U’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife 
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P − Q + R − S ÷ T × U

It means: P is the Brother of Q, Q is the Mother of R, R is the Brother of S, S is the Father of T and T is the wife of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3c0eef7df69fe9894f499a31f7e362c63ed31ed8c16ea59f8eaf8cf63a769ee.png] 

So, T is the 'Son’s daughter' of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
